title.zh: 站点性能 - Coinbase 网页/移动端

current_state.zh: 9月21日，Coinbase 报告 Web/Mobile 站点性能事件，称客户可能无法在多项服务上买入、卖出、交易或查看余额；公司表示资金安全，并于太平洋夏令时17:31将事件标记为已解决。
current_state.en: On Sep 21, Coinbase reported a site performance incident for Web/Mobile, saying customers may be unable to buy, sell, trade, or view balances on multiple services; it said funds were safe and later marked the incident resolved at 17:31 PDT.

updates.detailed_summary_en: On Sep 21, Coinbase reported a site performance incident for Web/Mobile, saying customers may be unable to buy, sell, trade, or view balances on multiple services; it said funds were safe and later marked the incident resolved at 17:31 PDT.
updates.background_zh: Coinbase 设有公开的状态页面，用于记录影响其网页端和移动端平台的事故，并以时间戳更新追踪每起事件从调查、监控到解决的整个过程。
updates.background_en: Coinbase maintains a public status page that logs incidents affecting its web and mobile platforms, with timestamped updates tracking each incident from investigation through monitoring to resolution.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次中断仅限于 Coinbase 自身的网页端与移动端界面；在这类故障期间，原本经由该交易所的订单流可能被延迟或转向其他交易场所，而用户无法查看余额也可能在短期内增加对持仓状况的不确定性。
updates.market_impact_en: The disruption was confined to Coinbase's own web and mobile interfaces; during such outages, order flow that would normally route through the exchange can be delayed or diverted to other venues, and users' inability to view balances can add short-term uncertainty about positions.
